How to join event
Performer slots (timetable)
Following section serves strictly for entering performer names. Please read further instructions
  • Always try to find performer by typing in first few letters and choosing from autocomplete result. If performer you want to enter is not in suggestions, you can create them by choosing last option in dropdown starting with "[Create new performer]". Please don't create duplicate performers with slightly different names and don't enter text that you want to be shown in performer slot. This input is meant only for entering performers.
  • Each performer needs to be entered as separate entry.
    This is incorrect way of entering performers in slot:

    Correct way to enter multiple performers in one slot:
  • Each performer slot can have one of following types:
    • Performers: surprisingly for entering performers.
    • Intermission: this slot type is useful for events that contains intermissions or other activities that are not performances. Intermission can be max 30 minutes long and can not be placed at the start or end of event.
    • TBD: use this type if you want to publish event but you don't have finalised lineup. This must be replaced by actual performer before event starts. This is not for signalling open decks! Open decks starts after event end.

Event tags

NSFW events are allowed on Timeline in certain categories, but main aspect of event must still be in line with chosen event category.

NSFW events will be visible only to logged in users.

If you adding event that has SFW and NSFW part, that is NSFW event.

Instance only accessible to 18+ age verified VRChat players.

Use "severe" if visual elements/effects that can flash rapidly and brightly can take up big portion of field of view.
i.e. Video screens, AreaLit/LTCGI, VRSL lights, screenspace shaders, audiolinked shaders, fog affected by video, etc.

Use "mild" only if effects less severe and are concentrated in one part of map so player can quickly avoid effects by turning away from them.

Use "with toggle" if you provide options to turn effects off at spawn point.

Windows - event map is compatible with Windows platform

Android - event map is compatible with Android (Quest) platform

iOS - event map is compatible with iOS platform
